prompts.sword: Use case: stylized-concept. Korean Three Kingdoms RPG inventory sprite ATLAS. Six ancient Korean sword AND round shield pairs in exact 3-column 2-row grid. Reference image establishes mandatory pose, style and angle. EVERY blade tip at UPPER LEFT and hilt/pommel at LOWER RIGHT, a 45 degree diagonal backslash, shield behind on RIGHT. Use identical angle, footprint and camera for all six pairs. Reading order: 1 plain steel iron sword and plain wooden bronze-boss shield; 2 CHILJIDO seven-branched sword, straight main blade plus three short branch blades on EACH side (seven tips total), gold hilt blue tassel, round blue lotus shield; 3 royal golden straight sword with red gem and round crimson sun shield; 4 luminous pale gold heavenly straight sword and white-gold cloud shield; 5 dark steel crimson steadfast sword and red-black fortress shield; 6 dark red/gold dragon straight sword and dark-gold sun shield. Preserve the seven-branched blade identity of item2 BUT point its center blade tip UPPER LEFT just like all other items. No item may point upper right. All handles lower right. Hand-painted 2D anime game art, warm crisp brown outlines, material texture, same shading density as reference. True transparent alpha background, NO backdrop/gradient/floor, no text/numbers/labels/UI. Each object centered inside inner65% of its equal grid cell, generous empty margins, no overlap, nothing cropped.
